correctness_audit.methodology: Per-row independent canonical predicates and state assertions; existing independent trade audit for every trade; origin/prefix timestamps; causal EMA/rolling/session cumulative implementations unchanged; captured sole accounting calls.

cost_attribution.limitation: Exact raw-versus-fill leg drag at actual quantities; not a zero-slippage strategy comparator. No rerun.

qualitative_evidence.policy: No new numeric threshold; mixed/negative qualitative evidence is NOT ESTABLISHED.

limitations: First exposure under preregistration; prior research informed broad direction; not universal out-of-sample proof
execution_note: Every completed regular bar advances Strategy I once. Existing pending-next-bar eligibility, engine entry/exit/risk order and policy are retained. Blocked signals are diagnostic only and never executed late.
report_notes: Funnel blocker counts may overlap: a BUY signal was both position-blocked and cutoff-blocked.
Entry conversion uses entered trades / reclaims; deviation conversion also supplied. Lag medians use the relevant reclaimed or entered subsets.
Risk exposure includes adverse exit slippage and explicit charges at modeled stop, so it exceeds the nominal 1% price-distance sizing budget.

Side/exit max_drawdown fields inherited from the diagnostic aggregation helper sum only selected canonical trade P&Ls from a nominal base; they are not independently sized portfolios or candidate runs. Only full-period and chronological-half drawdowns are used for interpretation.
Muhurat SELL deviation at first bar uses the unchanged floating-point VWAP result (907.9499999999999 versus close 907.95); no tolerance or indicator change introduced.
PF is gross profit / gross loss; null when no gross loss. Wins/losses use net P&L.
